result.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the diff lowercases only the blacklist entries (`process.env.BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.split(",").map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`) but compares the raw, untrimmed guest string (`!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`), so 'Spam@X.com' or ' b@x.com' bypasses the blacklist. Also 'Spam@X.com' would evade attendee-duplicate matching. This bypass is a real security/correctness defect introduced by this diff.
